news.title: “I’m Not a Suit” – Holly Longdale Q&A at PAX Australia
news.description: During her keynote presentation at PAX Aus, Holly Longdale answered questions about her career and leadership style.

news.title: These Famous Weapons Have NOT Been Nerfed
news.description: Despite rumors, Blizzard has confirmed that weapons such as Outlaw Sabre and Thrash Blade will not be nerfed in WoW Forever.

news.title: Druids Can Now Hold Torches With Their Mouths – WoW Forever
news.description: Blizzard has heard player feedback, and Druids can now hold torches while Shapeshifted on the WoW Forever beta!

news.title: The Leveling Journey in WoW Forever – Your Adventure Begins
news.description: During the WoW Forever leveling journey, players can experience over 1,000 new quests, explore 9 new dungeons, and find more ways to travel!

news.title: Class Deep Dives, Dungeons, PvP in Forever, Store Additions in Retail, New Patch for BCCA: WoW Weekly, October 5 – 9
news.description: A big weekly overview this time, with Forever class details, dungeons, and PvP, retail store additions, a new BCCA patch, and more!

news.title: Players Can Test Out World of Warcraft Forever’s New Legacy System With 16 Legacy Points
news.description: Blizzard gave players free points to test the Legacy System in Forever. Players can get talents early, gather more scarce material, and more!

news.title: WoW Forever Confirms Horde Players Aren’t Welcome in Dalaran
news.description: WoW Forever is putting a stop to Horde players’ Dalaran access, keeping faction conflict alive and Kirin Tor reputation exclusive!

news.title: We’re Giving Away 7 WoW Forever Collection Keys
news.description: We are giving away 7 Warcraft Forever Collector keys and here's how you can enter!
